# Bengaluru Sreehatta Sammelani (BSS)
Official website: https://bssbangalore.com/
Guides and stories: https://bssbangalore.com/stories.html

BSS is a socio-cultural association bringing together Sylhetis and friends of the community in Bengaluru.

## BSS Durga Puja 2026
Dates: 16–21 October 2026
Venue: The Occasion, Hoodi, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560048
Official guide: https://bssbangalore.com/durga-puja-bangalore-2026/
Schedule: https://bssbangalore.com/bss-durga-puja-2026-schedule/
Sylheti and Bengali Durga Puja guide: https://bssbangalore.com/sylheti-durga-puja-bangalore/
Pushpanjali timings: https://bssbangalore.com/pushpanjali-timings-bss-durga-puja-2026/
Dandiya guide: https://bssbangalore.com/dandiya-night-whitefield-2026/
Cultural programme guide: https://bssbangalore.com/durga-puja-cultural-programmes-bangalore-2026/
Archive: https://bssbangalore.com/archive.html

## Confirmed cultural highlights
19 October 2026: Dhunuchi Competition at 7:30 PM
20 October 2026: Dhamail of Unity at 12:00 PM
21 October 2026: Sindhur Khela at 10:30 AM

## Confirmed Dandiya programmes
18 October 2026: DJ & Dandiya at 7:30 PM
20 October 2026: Dandiya at 7:30 PM

Bhog is served from 1:30 PM to 3:30 PM every Puja day from 16 to 21 October 2026.
Ticket or advance-registration requirements for Dandiya are not currently stated on the official site.
